snippet.title: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School demo trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School by Coin Crew Games and published by @Iam8bit  has an updated demo out!

Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School in the Thinky Games DB:
